content: Spoken-SQuAD is chosen as the target domain data for training and testing. Spoken-SQuAD BIBREF5 is an automatically generated corpus in which the document is in spoken form and the question is in text form. The reference transcriptions are from SQuAD BIBREF1 . There are 37,111 and 5,351 question answer pairs in the training and testing sets respectively, and the word error rate (WER) of both sets is around 22.7%.
